top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a mature, independently confirmed design principle: a small molecule forms a ternary complex that hands a chosen protein to the ubiquitin-proteasome system, enabling catalytic removal of targets without druggable active sites. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated it; Ciulli supplied the VHL ligands, all-small-molecule degraders and ternary-complex structures that made it a general design method. The citation names induced proximity so it does not ignore molecular glues. P002 (Handa instead of Ciulli) is a close second; P003 and P004 split the prize with base editing, which is less settled on distinctness from the CRISPR prize and on credit.
